benchmarks.note: Land benchmarks: residential ¥/tsubo by station, triangulated from MLIT transaction data via Utinokati (multi-year) and 2026 official residential land-price points via Totinokati/tochidai: Ichikawa ~125 (official residential points run 132–146 at a 9–15 minute walk and the tax-valuation series implies ~124; the raw station transaction average of ~95 pools 16+ minute fringe deals and is not used, and the district regression of ~137 rests on only 24 analysis deals), Ichikawa-Mama ~130 and Sugano ~130 (proxies from official points — Mama 2-chome and Sugano 3-chome both print ~144 — and Sugano-side district transactions ~125–132), Motoyawata ~110 (137 transactions average ~102 and the official series implies ~109; tochidai's all-use station average of ~306 is station-front commercial — Yawata 2-chome alone is ~919 — and is not used), Keisei-Yawata ~120 and Onigoe ~100 (proxies: Yawata district transactions print ~145 on 19 deals while Onigoe's ~132 rests on just 5 deals against an all-period ~93–97, so both are scored below the thin prints), Shimosa-Nakayama ~95, Baraki-Nakayama ~78, Gyotoku ~125 and Myoden ~120 (their raw transaction averages of ~164 and ~141 are small-lot, station-front-skewed prints on 25 and 17 deals — Gyotoku-Ekimae commercial deals reach ~211 — while the official series implies ~123–126 and Myoden district's own regression is ~105), Minami-Gyotoku ~115, Ichikawa-Ono ~45 (transactions ~42 on 48 deals and official points 44–50 converge), Oomachi ~28 (pear-farming fringe; the district's ¥22.5 基準地価 average includes farm and forest points). Ichikawa-Shiohama (~90) and Futamata-Shinmachi (~45) are flagged very-low-confidence proxies for Keiyo-line stations whose surroundings are industrial-exclusive zoning with no residential market — any listing there actually sits in a neighbouring district and should be scored there. City-wide, urbanisation-control （調整区域） deals average ~37万円/坪 (52 deals) and drag every northern catchment they touch. Walk bands use Ichikawa's observed gradient — land prices fall roughly 33% by a 10-minute walk (city regression) and over 50% by 16+ minutes (transactions: 134.3万円/坪 within 5 minutes vs 58.7 at 16+); house prices fall only ~15% by 10 minutes and ~35% by 16+. Used houses transacted at about ¥139万/tsubo city-wide (floor-area basis, standardised; 2025 simple average ~150): Gyotoku ~167, Myoden ~162, Motoyawata ~158 at the top, Ichikawa-Ono ~105 in the north; by age, ≤10-yr stock ~173 falls to ~95 for 30+-yr stock. The district house prints of ~316 for Futamata (13 deals) and ~233 for Takaya (17 deals) are mix artefacts and are ignored. Official residential land prices rose +3.4% in the 2026 基準地価 survey (station pockets +4–6%) — a steady, broad rise, slightly slower than 2025's +3.9%.
